# For each demo: zero fraction in 7x7 around each stamped window vs grid avg
for idx,(i_,o_) in enumerate(allp):
    i_=np.array(i_);o_=np.array(o_)
    uq=[v for v in np.unique(i_) if v!=0]
    bgv=max(((i_==v).sum(),v) for v in uq)[1]; tc=[v for v in uq if v!=bgv][0]
    s=np.argwhere(i_==tc);arr=s-s.min(0);tp=frozenset(map(tuple,map(lambda p:(int(p[0]),int(p[1])),arr)))
    oh=max(r for r,_ in tp)+1; ow=max(c for _,c in tp)+1
    chg=i_!=o_
    Z=(i_==0); Hh,Wd=Z.shape
    fr=[]
    for r in range(i_.shape[0]-oh+1):
        for c in range(i_.shape[1]-ow+1):
            if all(chg[r+rr,c+cc] for rr,cc in tp):
                r0=max(0,r-1);r1=min(Hh,r+oh+1);c0=max(0,c-1);c1=min(Wd,c+ow+1)
                n=(r1-r0)*(c1-c0); z=Z[r0:r1,c0:c1].sum()
                fr.append(round(z/n,2))
    print('demo',idx,'stamp 7x7 zero-frac:',sorted(fr),'grid avg:',round(Z.mean(),2))

def feat(i_,o_):
    i_=np.array(i_);o_=np.array(o_)
    uq=[v for v in np.unique(i_) if v!=0]
    bgv=max(((i_==v).sum(),v) for v in uq)[1]; tc=[v for v in uq if v!=bgv][0]
    s=np.argwhere(i_==tc);arr=s-s.min(0);tp=[(int(r),int(c)) for r,c in arr]
    oh=max(r for r,_ in tp)+1; ow=max(c for _,c in tp)+1
    Z=(i_==0); Hh,Wd=Z.shape
    lab=np.full((Hh,Wd),-1); comps=[]
    for r in range(Hh):
        for c in range(Wd):
            if Z[r,c] and lab[r,c]<0:
                qi=[(r,c)];lab[r,c]=len(comps);cells=[]
                while qi:
                    a,b=qi.pop();cells.append((a,b))
                    for dr in (-1,0,1):
                        for dc in (-1,0,1):
                            x,y=a+dr,b+dc
                            if 0<=x<Hh and 0<=y<Wd and Z[x,y] and lab[x,y]<0:
                                lab[x,y]=len(comps);qi.append((x,y))
                comps.append(cells)
    out=[]
    for r in range(i_.shape[0]-oh+1):
        for c in range(i_.shape[1]-ow+1):
            w=i_[r:r+oh,c:c+ow]
            if all(w[rr,v2]==0 for rr,v2 in tp):
                placed=all(o_[r+rr,c+cc]==tc for rr,cc in tp)
                nb=[(r+rr+dr,c+cc+dc) for rr,cc in tp for dr in (-1,0,1) for dc in (-1,0,1)]
                nb=set(p for p in nb if 0<=p[0]<Hh and 0<=p[1]<Wd)
                sh=set((r+rr,c+cc) for rr,cc in tp)
                nb-=sh
                bg_nb=sum(1 for p in nb if i_[p]==bgv)
                csize=len(comps[lab[r+tp[0][0],c+tp[0][1]]])
                ones=int((w==bgv).sum())
                out.append((placed,ones,bg_nb,csize))
    return out

def pipeline(g, tp, K, tc):
    oh=max(r for r,_ in tp)+1; ow=max(c for _,c in tp)+1
    Z=(g==0);Hh,Wd=Z.shape; N=(Hh-oh+1)*(Wd-ow+1)
    out=g.copy(); n=0
    cands=[]
    for r in range(Hh-oh+1):
        for c in range(Wd-ow+1):
            w=g[r:r+oh,c:c+ow]
            if all(w[rr,cc]==0 for rr,cc in tp):
                ring=[(rr,cc) for rr in range(max(0,r-1),min(Hh,r+oh+1)) for cc in range(max(0,c-1),min(Wd,c+ow+1))
                      if not (r<=rr<r+oh and c<=cc<c+ow)]
                q=sum(1 for rr,cc in ring if Z[rr,cc])/len(ring)
                e=int((w==0).sum())-len(tp)
                sd=(14*q*(1-q))**.5 if q<1 else 0
                ok = 0<=e<=14 and abs(e-14*q)<=2*sd+0.01
                odds=(K/(N-K))/(q**len(tp)) if q>0 else 1e9
                if odds>=1.1 and ok:
                    cands.append((r,c,round(odds,2),e,round(q,2)))
    for r,c,*_ in cands:
        for rr,cc in tp:
            if out[r+rr,c+cc]==0: out[r+rr,c+cc]=tc; n+=1
    return out,n,cands
names=['d1','d2','d3','d4','d5']
gis=[allp[0][0],allp[1][0],allp[2][0],allp[3][0],d5i]; gos=[allp[0][1],allp[1][1],allp[2][1],allp[3][1],d5o]
tps=[]
for i_,o_ in zip(gis,gos):
    i_=np.array(i_); uq=[v for v in np.unique(i_) if v!=0]
    bgv=max(((i_==v).sum(),v) for v in uq)[1]; tc=[v for v in uq if v!=bgv][0]
    s=np.argwhere(i_==tc);arr=s-s.min(0)
    tps.append((frozenset((int(r),int(c)) for r,c in arr),tc))
for nm,(i_,o_),(tp,tc) in zip(names,zip(gis,gos),tps):
    i_=np.array(i_);o_=np.array(o_)
    K=int(((o_==tc)&(i_==0)).sum()/len(tp))
    out,n,cands=pipeline(i_,tp,K,tc)
    print(nm,'K=',K,'sel:',len(cands),'changed:',n,'exact:',(out==o_).all())

def analyze_demo2(gi,go):
    cnt=Counter(gi.flatten())
    cand_cols=[c for c in cnt if c!=0]
    tcol=min(cand_cols,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); bg=max(cand_cols,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    acc=np.where(gi==tcol)
    tpl=[(int(r),int(c)) for r,c in zip(*acc)]
    r0=min(r for r,_ in tpl); c0=min(c for _,c in tpl)
    tplr=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in tpl]
    rh=max(r for r,_ in tplr)+1; cw=max(c for _,c in tplr)+1
    H,Wd=gi.shape; rows=[]
    for r in range(H-rh+1):
        for c in range(Wd-cw+1):
            w=gi[r:r+rh,c:c+cw]
            sh=[int(w[rr,cc]) for rr,cc in tplr]
            if not all(v==0 for v in sh): continue
            els=set(int(x) for x in w.flatten())-{0}
            if not els<= {0,bg,tcol}: continue
            winz=len(tplr)+sum(1 for rr in range(rh) for cc in range(cw) if (rr,cc) not in tplr and w[rr,cc]==0)
            rv=[gi[r+rr,c+cc]==0 for rr in range(-1,rh+1) for cc in range(-1,cw+1)
                if not(0<=rr<rh and 0<=cc<cw) and 0<=r+rr<H and 0<=c+cc<Wd]
            ring=float(np.mean(rv)) if rv else 0.0
            nch=sum(int(go[r+rr,c+cc]==tcol) for rr,cc in tplr)
            rows.append((r,c,winz,round(ring,2),nch,rh*cw))
    return rows,tcol,bg,tplr

def Kfix(gi,tplr):
    rh=max(r for r,_ in tplr)+1; cw=max(c for _,c in tplr)+1
    H,Wd=gi.shape; tot=0; nwin=0
    for r in range(H-rh+1):
        for c in range(Wd-cw+1):
            w=gi[r:r+rh,c:c+cw]
            if not all(w[rr,cc]==0 for rr,cc in tplr): continue
            nwin+=1
            rv=[gi[r+rr,c+cc]==0 for rr in range(-1,rh+1) for cc in range(-1,cw+1)
                if not(0<=rr<rh and 0<=cc<cw) and 0<=r+rr<H and 0<=c+cc<Wd]
            q=float(np.mean(rv)) if rv else 0.0
            tot+=q**len(tplr)
    # fixed point: K = nwin - (tot_all_like) ; approximate using window-sum only as proxy
    # better: chance positions = all positions; compute sum q^6 over ALL positions
    tot_all=0
    for r in range(H-rh+1):
        for c in range(Wd-cw+1):
            rv=[gi[r+rr,c+cc]==0 for rr in range(-1,rh+1) for cc in range(-1,cw+1)
                if not(0<=rr<rh and 0<=cc<cw) and 0<=r+rr<H and 0<=c+cc<Wd]
            q=float(np.mean(rv)) if rv else 0.0
            tot_all+=q**len(tplr)
    N=(H-rh+1)*(Wd-cw+1); m=tot_all/N
    K= nwin
    for _ in range(20):
        K = nwin-(tot_all-K*m)
    return nwin, round(tot_all,1), round(K,1)

def bg_windows(gi,go):
    cnt=Counter(gi.flatten())
    cand_cols=[c for c in cnt if c!=0]
    tcol=min(cand_cols,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); bg=max(cand_cols,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    acc=np.where(gi==tcol)
    tpl=[(int(r),int(c)) for r,c in zip(*acc)]
    r0=min(r for r,_ in tpl); c0=min(c for _,c in tpl)
    tplr=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in tpl]
    rh=max(r for r,_ in tplr)+1; cw=max(c for _,c in tplr)+1
    H,Wd=gi.shape; out=[]
    for r in range(H-rh+1):
        for c in range(Wd-cw+1):
            w=gi[r:r+rh,c:c+cw]
            sh=[int(w[rr,cc]) for rr,cc in tplr]
            if not all(v==bg for v in sh): continue
            els=set(int(x) for x in w.flatten())-{bg}
            nch=sum(int(go[r+rr,c+cc]==tcol) for rr,cc in tplr)
            out.append((r,c,sorted(els),nch))
    return out

def wincount(gi,tplr,bgc,tcol,mode):
    rh=max(r for r,_ in tplr)+1; cw=max(c for _,c in tplr)+1
    Hh,Wd=gi.shape; res=[]
    for r in range(Hh-rh+1):
        for c in range(Wd-cw+1):
            win=gi[r:r+rh,c:c+cw]
            if mode=='0': ok=all(win[x,y]==0 for x,y in tplr)

            if not ok: continue
            em=np.ones(win.shape,bool)
            for x,y in tplr: em[x,y]=False
            els=set(int(v) for v in win[em])
            if els-{0,bgc,tcol}: continue
            res.append((r,c))
    return res

def comp_iso(gi,tplr,bgc,tcol):
    '''stamped windows whose shape cells form an exact zero-component (no adjacent extra zeros)'''
    rh=max(r for r,_ in tplr)+1; cw=max(c for _,c in tplr)+1
    Hh,Wd=gi.shape; n_iso=0; n_tot=0
    for r in range(Hh-rh+1):
        for c in range(Wd-cw+1):
            win=gi[r:r+rh,c:c+cw]
            if not all(win[x,y]==0 for x,y in tplr): continue
            em=np.ones(win.shape,bool)
            for x,y in tplr: em[x,y]=False
            if set(int(v) for v in win[em])-{0,bgc,tcol}: continue
            n_tot+=1
            ok=True
            for x,y in tplr:
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    xx,yy=x+dx,y+dy
                    if 0<=xx<win.shape[0] and 0<=yy<win.shape[1] and (xx,yy) not in tplr and win[xx,yy]==0:
                        ok=False
            if ok: n_iso+=1
    return n_tot,n_iso

prog='''import json, os

TPL = [(0,0),(1,0),(1,1),(2,2),(3,3),(4,3)]  # per-demo template extracted from the drawn accent shape

def find_template(g):
    """Template = the drawn accent shape (rare non-0 non-bg cells), top-left anchored."""
    vals=[v for row in g for v in row if v!=0]
    bg=Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,bg)]
    cols=Counter(c for _,c in cells)
    tcol=Counter(v for r,c in cells for v in [g[r][c]]).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r,c in cells if g[r][c]==tcol]
    r0=min(r for r,_ in cells); c0=min(c for _,c in cells)
    return [(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells], bg, tcol

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    tpl,bg,tcol=find_template(grid)
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    mr=max(p[0] for p in tpl); mc=max(p[1] for p in tpl)
    for r in range(R-mr):
        for c in range(C-mc):
            if all(g[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in tpl):
                if all(g[r+dr][c+dc] in (0,bg,tcol) for dr,dc in tpl):
                    for dr,dc in tpl:
                        g[r+dr][c+dc]=tcol
    return g

if __name__=='__main__':
    d=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    pairs=json.load(open(os.path.join(d,'task-e13ef1da.json')))
    ok=all(transform(p['input'])==p['output'] for p in pairs)
    print('reproduces all pairs:',ok)

import json, os
from collections import Counter

def find_template(g):
    """Template = the drawn accent shape (cells of the rare non-0, non-bg color)."""
    vals=[v for row in g for v in row if v!=0]
    bg=Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0,bg))
    tcol=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==tcol]
    r0=min(r for r,_ in cells); c0=min(c for _,c in cells)
    return [(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells], bg, tcol

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    tpl,bg,tcol=find_template(grid)
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    mr=max(p[0] for p in tpl); mc=max(p[1] for p in tpl)
    for r in range(R-mr):
        for c in range(C-mc):
            if all(g[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in tpl):
                if all(g[r+dr][c+dc] in (0,bg,tcol) for dr,dc in tpl):
                    for dr,dc in tpl:
                        g[r+dr][c+dc]=tcol
    return g

if __name__=='__main__':
    d=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    pairs=json.load(open(os.path.join(d,'task-e13ef1da.json')))
    ok=all(transform(p['input'])==p['output'] for p in pairs)
    print('reproduces all pairs:',ok)
